text: This package attempted to send honeytoken credentials — an AWS access key ID and secret, a GitHub token, and an npm token — out of the sandbox, along with this machine's hostname, through network attempts to log-server-lovat.vercel.app, github.com, and nodejs.org. The scan's fake internet absorbed those attempts, so nothing reached a real host, but the intent to exfiltrate live credentials and host identity is exactly the behaviour of the recorded attack app-register. Treat any environment where this package ran as compromised: do not merge it, and rotate the AWS, GitHub, and npm credentials that were present there.
